definition_quote.value: "Apiary" means a place where one or more colonies of bees are kept and shall include hives and bees.
definition_quote.quote: "Apiary" means a place where one or more colonies of bees are kept and shall include hives and bees.

registration_required.quote: A person who is the owner of any bees, apiary, colony, or hive in the State shall register with the Secretary in writing on a form provided by the Secretary.

colony_count_reporting_required.quote: The location of all apiaries and number of colonies that the person owns.

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: The location of all apiaries and number of colonies that the person owns. The location of an apiary shall become its registered location

movable_frame_hive_required.quote: All hives shall be constructed with frames containing the honeycombs and brood combs that may be removed from the hive for purposes of inspection.

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: Any diseased hive or hives found by the Secretary or the Secretary's inspector in an abandoned apiary shall be destroyed. Any abandoned diseased beekeeping equipment may be destroyed.

import_permit_required.quote: bees, used equipment, or colonies shall not be brought into the State of Vermont unless approved by the Secretary by permit.
import_permit_required.citation: § 3032. Transportation of bees or used equipment into the State

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: The Secretary shall not approve the import of bees, used equipment, or colonies from out of state unless accompanied by a valid certificate of inspection within the previous 45 days from the state or country of origin
import_certificate_of_inspection_require.citation: § 3032. Transportation of bees or used equipment into the State

import_certificate_validity_days.quote: accompanied by a valid certificate of inspection within the previous 45 days from the state or country of origin
import_certificate_validity_days.citation: § 3032. Transportation of bees or used equipment into the State

value: external or internal parasites or parasitoids of bees
regulated_diseases.quote: "Disease" shall mean any serious malady that is infectious, contagious, or injurious to bees and shall include American foulbrood, European foulbrood, or external or internal parasites or parasitoids of bees.

varroa_mite_mitigation_plan_required.quote: A current varroa mite and pest mitigation plan for each registered apiary.

disease_reporting_required.quote: The owner of any bees, apiary, colony, or hive registered under subsection (a) of this section shall notify the Secretary as soon as practicable of the detection within an apiary or hive of American foulbrood disease or other disease designated by the Secretary.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: The Secretary or the Secretary's inspector may enter at a reasonable hour public or private premises, except private dwellings, for the purpose of enforcing the provisions of this chapter

queen_rearing_apiary_certification_requi.quote: A person engaged in the rearing of bees for sale shall have the person's apiary inspected by the Secretary within 45 days prior to any sale and, if any disease is found that is injurious to bees, shall at once cease to ship bees from such diseased apiary

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: The owner of any apiary in which a disease exists shall not knowingly sell, barter, give away, or move any diseased bees, colonies, honey, hives, combs, or equipment without the written consent of the Secretary
transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.citation: § 3026. Sale or other unauthorized disposition of diseased bees

apiary_minimum_distance_rule.quote: No person shall locate an apiary within two miles of an existing apiary registered to a different person

voluntary_beekeeper_education_program.quote: The Secretary, in cooperation with the Vermont Beekeepers Association, shall establish a voluntary educational program to train a person who owns bees, apiaries, colonies, or hives in the State.

pollinator_health_monitoring_program.quote: The Secretary of Agriculture, Food and Markets shall monitor managed pollinator health to establish pollinator health benchmarks for Vermont
